tasks.build:db: deno run -A scripts/build-db.ts && deno run -A scripts/docs.ts
tasks.prototype: deno run -A scripts/build-db.ts && deno run -A design/prototype/build.ts

dev.description: Run the sandbox runner and the web app together

build:web.description: Build the app, then drop web/_headers at the root of the assets directory Cloudflare uploads
build:web.command: deno task --cwd web build && cp web/_headers web/_fresh/client/_headers

tasks.preview: deno task build:web && npx --yes wrangler@4 dev
tasks.deploy: deno task build:web && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
